dataList.content:
<Wow, I guess that wasn't an exaggeration at all... It all really happened in the blink of an eye.>
<真的一瞬间就到了……看来并不是夸大其词啊。>

As always, Faust was giving me her usual look, which was a complete lack of any emotive expression.
浮士德像往常一样，面无表情地看着我。

Which, I suppose, is why it didn't immediately register that something had gone awry.
所以直到那一刻前，我都完全没能意识到事情复杂起来了。

No, we have not yet arrived at our destination.
不。我们并未抵达。

<Huh?>
<嗯？>

But once I finally came to and had some time to digest that odd reply, I looked up at her face once again...
但当我的意识逐渐清醒过来……并因为这个意料之外的答案产生疑惑时，便静静地看着浮士德。

... and realized that her expression was more antsy than usual by a microscopically minuscule degree.
这时，我终于意识到，浮士德的表情比起平时要更加焦虑不安。

<So... this train is still "running"?>
<所以……这辆列车现在还在“运行中”吗？>

Yes.
是的。

<Then... where are we?>
<那……我们现在在哪？>

... I believe we are currently stranded in an unidentified dimension. Coordinates: unknown.
……我认为我们正漂流在具体坐标未知的某一次元当中。

I took a reflexive, deep breath from the sheer horror of the numerous implications stuffed into that dryly delivered sentence.
这句平淡托出的话，却让我感到脊背发凉，不由咽了口唾沫。

When that passed, the first thing that struck my mind was that we were about to suffer the very thing that we were so worried about.
我会亲身经历自己最初所担心的问题吗？这样的念头闪过我的脑海。

But I soon found myself calming down.
接着，我脑海中浮现出的是……

Yeah, this had to be a part of Faust's plan. She probably saw this coming from a mile away.
没错，这可能也是浮士德的预想情况之一吧。

I'm sure she's about to proudly tell me every little detail of her plan that will help us out of this situation.
从现在起，浮士德很快就会指导我该如何行动以应对这一情况了吧。

<But this is all just a part of the plan, right? Faust?>
<……这也是全部计划中的一部分吧，浮士德？>

... That was an unusually long silence from Faust.
今天的浮士德，沉默的时间比以往要长。

You are half correct, yet half incorrect.
半对，半错。

With that, Faust left me to flounder in the chaotic stream of vaguely terrifying information as she began stopping by each capsule to wake the Sinners.
留下这样的话后，浮士德留下陷入混乱当中的我，走向胶囊舱，将其中的罪人们一个个地叫醒。

Ooh, we're here already? Man, it really happened in the blink of an—
哦，已经到站了吗？真的是眨眼之间就……

No.
不。

Ooh, what's this? We're here already, for real? It really happened in the blink of an—
哦，怎么。真的已经到站了吗？真的是眨眼间就……

No.
不。

Whoa, w-we're here already? I guess I really was worrying over nothi—
哇。到、到站了吗？一点也不像我想得那么吓……

No.
不。

O—
哦……

No.
不。

I have not uttered a single word yet...
我还没有发言呢……

There was a brief cheer, a little hurrah about regaining our colors, followed by a flat-toned explanation of our current predicament, which was then followed by a long, loaded silence...
... which was a sequence of events I had the pleasure of watching play out on about ten consecutive occasions...
为取回颜色而开心的短促欢呼伴随着叙述目前情况的平淡声音，再然后陷入长时间的沉默中……就这样反复了大约10次之后……

Dante. I understand your confusion, however... perhaps an elaboration of our present circumstance is necessary.
但丁，我知道你现在很混乱……总之我认为现在有必要再次详细解释一下目前的情况。

... And that brings us to the present.
……就这样，回到现在。

Let me get this right...
所以说……

This train's still running...
列车现在还在运行……

And we're drifting through some unknown dimension...?
我们被扔在了某个根本都不知道是哪的次元空间当中……？

Ooo... aught about that striketh me as quite dramatic.
哦哦……这听起来还挺戏剧性的……

Most importantly... Are you saying that you already knew that this would happen, Faust?
最重要的是……浮士德，你早就知道一切会这样发展……

... Yes.
……是的。

Haaaaah...
哈……

What... what the hell is wrong with you? Huh?
你……想干嘛啊？到底？

The Sinners each begin to voice their anger.
罪人们中间开始出现了一些抱怨的声音。

Of course, this wasn't the first time Faust and Vergilius intentionally and knowingly omitted certain details about what's to come.
当然，浮士德和维吉里乌斯事先就知道会发生什么却对我们有所隐瞒的事有很多。

Are you actually serious? It's not like we can just retreat or jump out that door when stuff hits the fan!
开什么玩笑？这儿可不是个计划出差错还能直接打开门撤出去的地方！

Opening the door will result in near-immediate destruction of the physical body.
如果打开门，在数秒内躯体就会支离破碎。

Hey, Fau... at least tell us you know what to do like you always do. You've got a plan, right?
但，小浮……我们接下来要做的都在计划当中，对吧？

... Right?
……对吧？

Faust, whom I had rarely ever seen at a loss for words... was unusually slow to respond.
至今为止，浮士德对大多数问题的回答都是游刃有余，但这次沉默的时间要比以往长得多。

Uh. What's up with her? Lass looks totally out of it today.
搞什么，这家伙怎么就在那呆站着？

She gives me a sideways glance.
浮士德朝我瞥了一眼。

... There must be something she can't discuss in front of the Sinners.
有什么……不方便在罪人们面前说的事吗？

<... Guys, let's pause for a bit.>
<……各位，稍等一下。>

She said that something unexpected's happened...
我又想起她曾说过发生了预料之外的情况……

The other Sinners' anger was completely understandable. It also makes sense that this continued lack of communication was harming our trust in Faust.
罪人们怒不可遏，对浮士德的信任度掉到谷底也是可以理解的。

<Alright. We're going to go over the situation from the start, okay?>
<总之先来整理一下情况吧。>

But just letting things play out might really turn everyone against Faust, and for good.
但如果在这种情况下任由产生的争执与摩擦继续发展下去，想要让大家的关系和好如初便再无可能。

Besides...
然后……

... I doubt Faust woke us up in the middle of the trip just to spite us.
我并不认为浮士德是怀揣着恶意做出这样的事的。

First things first, I gotta get the Sinners to calm down. Then I'll ask Faust to tell us what happened. If there's a problem, we'll figure it out and deal with it as we move along.
首先我得安抚一下罪人们的情绪，然后再去问问浮士德事情的来龙去脉。如果能够发现问题所在，我们就可以想办法将其解决了。

<Tell us what's going on, Faust. All of it. And in a way that we can all understand.>
<浮士德，将此事从头说起吧。好让我们大家都能了解。>

<Let's hear her out first. Is that okay with you guys?>
<让我们先听完她怎么说再下判断。好吗，各位？>

... If you say so. I'll go along with it.
……如果你如此判断的话。那就这样吧。

... Fine. I suppose losin' my rag rarely ever did anything.
也是……一直在这里生气也解决不了多少问题。

Thank you. Then...
感谢大家。那么……

After some time...
过了一段时间……

The gist of Faust's explanation was as follows.
浮士德所说的事情可以概括如下。

The cause of this issue, as always, involved a certain contract and a unilateral decision from the higher-ups of Limbus Company.
当然，事情的开端，是边狱公司高层的合同和命令，并且是促成现如今情况的决定性因素。

W Corp., having caught wind of Limbus Company's recent Distortion contract management promotions...
边狱公司处理扭曲相关委托的消息以及广受赞誉的宣传报道流传到了W公司。

... decided to contract us to deal with a mysterious, repeated series of incidents suspected to have been caused by a Distortion. After multiple failed attempts to resolve it on their own, of course.
当W公司内部无法处理列车上反复出现的一系列据推测可能是由于未知扭曲而引起的事件时，
他们便委托我们来解决此事。

The Distortions themselves likely did not pose a problem for W Corp. Based on the available information, it can be determined that they would have all been neutralized as soon as the train arrived, and any transformed passengers would have been reverted to their human forms.
扭曲现象本来应当是不会产生问题的。如果与我们掌握的信息相吻合的话，那么在WARP列车到站时，经由W公司所采取的措施，扭曲就会恢复成乘客的原状。

But...
但是……

The real issue was that the passengers were disappearing.
真正的问题在于，有的乘客会消失。

Passengers... spirited away?! Alas, such is an impossibility aboard these trains, is it not?
消失……？！就算想这么做，在这辆列车上也做不到吧！

That is the problem whose precise cause and effect we must determine.
包含这部分在内，我们需要探明这起事件的前因后果。

<Did W Corp. share anything to get us started?>
<W公司没提供什么信息以助于我们开始行动吗？>

... That appears to be the most prominent cause of this misunderstanding.
……这点似乎是造成此次误解的最主要原因。

She explained that W Corp. refused to share anything about the trains because they were concerned about disclosing the secrets of their Singularity.
W公司由于顾忌到自身奇点技术会泄露，所以并没有分享列车相关的事宜。

That's probably why they sought out an upstart business like Limbus Company to deal with this, now that I think about it...
也许这就是为什么他们会找上我们边狱公司这样一家新兴公司来着手处理……

We wouldn't even know where to start if we didn't have access to the information that the Identity Cards had to offer.
要不是通过人格卡获得了一些最基本的信息，我们甚至可能连从哪儿开始着手解决委托都摸不清。

Faust produced what appeared to be a keycard with the W Corp. logo on it before continuing with her explanations.
浮士德一边拿出一张印有W公司标志的钥匙卡向罪人们展示，一边继续说道。

However, we were given this master keycard that can open and close the hibernation capsules at any time.
不过，我得到了一张主钥匙卡。使用这个可以随时打开或关闭这些冬眠胶囊舱……

We may return to our respective capsules as soon as the contract is fulfilled and safely complete the rest of the journey as we had planned from the beginning.
委托完成之后，我相信我们就可以如在梅菲斯托费勒斯讨论过的那样，乘坐冬眠胶囊舱安全抵达目的地。

These bloody Wings... every single one of 'em's been absolutely barmy.
这些翼有一个算一个都这样，哈……

Hmm~ I think it's a bit unkind of them to ask us to finish the puzzle without all the important pieces...
嗯~我觉得把所有重要线索都隐藏起来，让人们自己寻找谜底多少有些不近人情了吧……

At least at T Corp., their Chief Executive Director tagged along as our assistant, not to mention kindly explaining so many new things to us.
至少T公司给了我们帅气的徽章，而且他们公司的代表还作为助手为我们讲解了许多事情呢。

I-it sounds like Miss Faust was stuck between a rock and a hard place herself...
浮、浮士德小姐一定很操劳吧……

Some Sinners grew more receptive after her explanations, albeit with a sigh.
听完解释后，一些罪人叹了口气，了解并接受了事情的原委。

... Haah. I would've appreciated it if you at least gave us a hint.
……呼。要是能给点暗示就好了。

Yeah. I understand where you're coming from, but it's not like there's someone out there monitoring everything you say and do, right?
是啊，我理解你的意思了。但浮士德小姐你的一举一动，也并非时刻都在监控之下吧？

That is...
那是……

Haaah...
哈啊……

... But not everyone was willing to let this go without saying their piece.
有些罪人还是感到不满，不过这也在意料之中。

... Next time, I will take your inputs into account.
……我今后会将你们的意见作为参考的。

... And that's just about all I can do for her. It's an undeniable fact that her actions have disappointed the Sinners.
……我能做的就到这了。浮士德的所作所为让罪人们感到失望，是无可争辩的事实。

This is Faust we're talking about, though. I'm sure she has backup plans of backup plans to get us out of this situation.
但她可不是别人而是浮士德啊，应该已经想好了各种打破现状的办法吧？

Hm. So what's next on our agenda?
嗯。那么，我们现在该如何是好？

Yeah~ What's done is done, right? Besides, it's not like we gotta rot away for thousands of years inside this metal box.
是啊~既然事情已经发生了就没办法啦。而且我们似乎并不会在这金属盒子里烂上千百万年。

... That, is something I must first discuss with Dante.
……关于那方面，我必须与经理讨论一番。

Discuss?
讨论？

But "discussing" things with other people is very unlike Faust.
这可不像是浮士德会说的话……

<... What are we discussing, Faust?>
<要……讨论点什么，浮士德？>

We must converse in a lower volume, Dante.
我建议我们小点声为好，但丁。

<Wh... why are we whispering...?>
<为……为何我们要窃窃私语……>

Her secretive attitude only exacerbated my already-battered sense of safety...
看着浮士德暗暗压低声音的样子，我心中先前掀起的不安开始越来越高涨……

... My connection to Gesellschaft... I mean, Faust, has been severed.
……我与Gesellschaft……我的意思是，我与浮士德，断开连接了。

<... I'm sorry, what?>
<……什么？>

I... cannot access Faust's knowledge at the moment.
我正处于……无法阅览浮士德的信息的状态。

And just like that, the ominous feeling I had turned out to be right.
不好的预感，竟就这样成真了。
